# Clipper2 Vendored Copy

Geometer vendors the C++ Clipper2 2.0.1 library from:

https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2

Only `CPP/Clipper2Lib/include`, `CPP/Clipper2Lib/src`, and the upstream
`LICENSE` are included. Examples, tests, and packaging files are intentionally
omitted.

Clipper2 is licensed under the Boost Software License 1.0. Geometer uses it for
generic planar polygon boolean and offset operations exposed through the v0.3
planar batch solve API.
